name: language-node-kind
body:
A new code-graph node kind `Language` (`NodeKind::Language`, DB label `Language`) exists, one per language actually scanned, derived ingestor-side from the existing `lang_switch` control record — NOT scanner-emitted. Frontends keep emitting facts only; the ingestor materialises exactly one Language node for each language stream it observes (the language id from `lang_switch`), and none for a language that was not scanned.

The node carries no location and no `code_type` (it is a namespace root, not a source declaration). The graph.jsonl export gains the Language records (an export/rebuild of the graph reproduces them), and the DB schema declares the label.

Acceptance: after a scan of a repo containing Rust and Python sources, `MATCH (l:Language) RETURN l.fqn` returns exactly `rust` and `py` (one per scanned language, none extra); a single-language repo yields one Language node; no scanner frontend emits a language record (the control record remains pipeline-side); the graph.jsonl export carries the Language records; a re-scan rebuilds the same Language nodes.
